stem.text: A battery is connected to a potentiometer. The potentiometer consists of a uniform resistance wire and a sliding contact P.

stem.alt: Potentiometer circuit with a battery connected across a horizontal resistance wire between Q and R, a sliding contact P on the wire, a voltmeter labelled V connected between P and Q, and a distance d marked between Q and P.

stem.text: The potential difference (p.d.) $V$ between the sliding contact P and end Q of the wire is measured using a voltmeter. The sliding contact P is moved from end Q to end R of the wire. Sliding contact P is distance $d$ from Q.
Which graph shows the variation with distance $d$ of the p.d. $V$?

A.alt: Graph with the vertical axis labelled V and the horizontal axis labelled d, origin marked 0, showing a straight line from the origin.

B.alt: Graph with the vertical axis labelled V and the horizontal axis labelled d, origin marked 0, showing a curve rising from the origin.

C.alt: Graph with the vertical axis labelled V and the horizontal axis labelled d, origin marked 0, showing a straight line falling from the vertical axis.

D.alt: Graph with the vertical axis labelled V and the horizontal axis labelled d, origin marked 0, showing a curve falling from the vertical axis.
